officialContext.helpArticle: https://help.ea.com/en/articles/battlefield/battlefield-6/class-guide/ (read 28 Sep 2026; page says updated about five months earlier): bonuses apply when a signature weapon is equipped; most modes use open weapons. Assault rifle: faster draw and sprint time, better sprint recovery. SMG: improved hip-fire control. LMG: faster ADS transition and no sprint speed penalty. Sniper: hold breath to stabilize aim, faster rechambering.

conditionalSiteValues.convention: Bare weapon, current site ladders (docs/STAT_LADDERS.md). Hip steps negated (index = base - mod), draw/sprint shifts negated, ADS animation step same sign. Deploy and undeploy share one index.
conditionalSiteValues.assault: All 11 ARs base index 5 -> 6: deploy 633.334 -> 533.334 ms, undeploy 233.334 -> 200.001 ms, sprint recovery 200.001 -> 166.667 ms.
conditionalSiteValues.engineer: All 10 SMGs hip row 4 -> 5: standing 1.804 -> 1.352 deg, moving 2.255 -> 1.690 deg; increase/decay unchanged.

inference: The GS GID index and the WB animation step are separate coordinates (as VSSM, W2); the displayed ADS time follows the WB animation index, so one ladder step is the site-relevant change.
Membership, source operands and the official class guide agree for Assault, Engineer and Support.
